Your information

Privacy.

How your booking information is handled.

Booking enquiries

This site uses the details you enter to prepare a text message or email addressed to Refined Detailing. The form does not submit those details to a website server, and no booking is sent until you send it from your messages or email app.

Information you share

Your name, phone number, vehicle, suburb and booking notes help Refined respond to your enquiry and arrange your detail. Avoid including sensitive information in the form.

External services

The service-area map is provided by Google Maps. Fonts are provided by Google Fonts. These services may receive technical information such as your IP address when they load. Links to Instagram open an external website. Those services have their own privacy policies.

Questions

For questions about an enquiry or information shared with Refined Detailing, email refined.detailing.newcastle@gmail.com or call 0431 484 541.
